citations.field: 大 entry; PDF p. 922, printed p. 907; continuation on PDF p. 923
citations.text: The inspected scan shows the 大 headword and its form chart, labeled 商, 西周, 春秋, 战国, 秦, 《说文》小篆, 汉 and 楷书. It calls 大 pictographic and describes the oracle and bronze forms as a frontal standing person with two hands spread and legs apart. It proposes ‘adult’ as the original sense and connects that to ‘big’. The page 922 entry continues on page 923, where it says 大 extends to ‘big’ across dimensions and cites oracle-bone and bronze phrases using 大. These are the book authors’ analyses; the cited forms and semantic link were not independently verified here against their cited publications or dated artifacts.
